title: Legion of Super-Heroes #305 DC November 1983 Keith Giffen Cover Paul Levitz
conditionDescription: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Legion of Super-Heroes #305 (November 1983), DC Comics. Written by Paul Levitz, cover by Keith Giffen and Larry Mahlstedt. Introduction of Micro Lad. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Parker Brothers James Bond 007 video game ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
